answer_1.quote: Non-collaborative dialogue ... aims to generate a multiturn dialogue {u p1 , u r1 , … } to gradually guide two dialogue participants ... by planning a series of strategies.

answer_2.quote: The evaluation metrics contain: Success Rate (SR) ... and Average Turn (AT) ... Additionally, we also used dataset-specific metrics: SL% for the CB dataset and ΔH for DC.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation (App. E) on the full test set of the CB dataset ... We consider the metrics of (1) persuasion success rate (PSR): the success (1) or not (0) of persuasion based on dialogue texts. (2) coherent: the coherence of dialogue and strategic planning on a scale of 1 (bad) to 5 (good).
answer_4.guideline: Metrics considered: (1) persuasion success rate (PSR) judged as success or failure based on dialogue texts, (2) coherence rated on a 1‑5 scale.
